bosnia_sun.datazione_ufficiale: Natural hill topped by a medieval fortress
bosnia_sun.funzione_ufficiale: Natural site with medieval archaeological remains
bosnia_sun.funzione_non_ufficiale: Ancient pyramid complex with energy properties
leggende_locali: Oral tales about the sacred hills of Visoko
Modern stories about the Bosnian pyramids and their energy
bosnia_sun.note: Osmanagich's most contested site. Mainstream science rejects any artificial origin; Osmanagich claims it is the largest and oldest pyramid in the world.

leggende_locali: Oral traditions of the Visoko area
bosnia_moon.note: The second pyramid of the Bosnian complex, according to Osmanagich.

bosnia_dragon.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of a worldwide pyramid network

bosnia_earth.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of a worldwide pyramid network
bosnia_earth.note: The fifth pyramid of the Bosnian complex.

bosnia_ravne_tunnels.funzione_non_ufficiale: An underground network linking the pyramids, with ionizing and healing properties
bosnia_ravne_tunnels.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: The builders of the Bosnian pyramids
leggende_locali: Tales of mysterious tunnels beneath Visoko
bosnia_ravne_tunnels.note: Osmanagich claims that the Ravne 1–5 tunnels form an underground network with ionizing and healing properties.

giza_great.funzione_non_ufficiale: Power plant, astronomical observatory, monument of a lost civilization
leggende_locali: Built by the gods, according to some traditions
The granaries of Joseph (medieval tradition)
giza_great.note: The largest and oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Osmanagich cites it as a reference for his work on the Bosnian pyramids.

giza_khafre.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of an energy or astronomical complex
giza_khafre.note: The second pyramid of Giza, still partly covered by its limestone casing. 136.4 m is its present height; it originally stood about 143.5 m.

giza_menkaure.note: The smallest of the three main pyramids of Giza.

saqqara_djoser.funzione_non_ufficiale: The first known pyramid, possibly a prototype
leggende_locali: Imhotep was deified as a god of medicine
saqqara_djoser.note: Considered the first monumental stone building in history.

dahshur_red.note: The first successfully completed smooth-sided pyramid.

dahshur_bent.funzione_non_ufficiale: An attempt at the perfect pyramid
dahshur_bent.note: The only pyramid with two different slopes, a record of how Egyptian architecture evolved.

teotihuacan_sun.funzione_non_ufficiale: Energy center, astronomical alignment, node of a worldwide pyramid network
leggende_locali: Built by the gods in the age of the 'Fifth Sun'
The place where the gods sacrificed themselves to create the world
teotihuacan_sun.note: Osmanagich counts Teotihuacan as part of a worldwide pyramid network.

teotihuacan_moon.funzione_non_ufficiale: Energy counterpart to the Pyramid of the Sun

cholula.tipo: Step pyramid (largest in the world by volume)
cholula.funzione_non_ufficiale: The largest pyramid in the world by volume, part of a worldwide network
cholula.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: An earlier civilization with advanced knowledge
leggende_locali: Built by the giant Xelhua after the great flood
cholula.note: With a volume of about 4.45 million m³, it is the largest pyramid ever built by volume.

la_danta.funzione_non_ufficiale: One of the most massive structures ever built, part of a worldwide network
leggende_locali: A sacred man-made mountain of the Maya
la_danta.note: Estimated volume of 2.8 million m³, one of the largest structures of the ancient world.

gunung_padang.datazione_ufficiale: Pottery dated 45 BC – AD 22; no accepted date older than 9,000 years
gunung_padang.datazione_non_ufficiale: Over 20,000 years (Danny Hilman Natawidjaja, backed by Osmanagich)
gunung_padang.funzione_non_ufficiale: The world's oldest pyramid, built by an Ice Age civilization
gunung_padang.popolazione_ufficiale_associata: Prehistoric peoples of the Indonesian archipelago
leggende_locali: Sacred mountain of light
A place of spiritual power
gunung_padang.note: Osmanagich has visited the site and sees it as evidence of a prehistoric worldwide pyramid network. A 2023 paper in Archaeological Prospection dating it to over 9,000 years ago was retracted by the publisher, Wiley, in March 2024.

xian_mausoleum.nome: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
xian_mausoleum.datazione_non_ufficiale: As dated, but possibly with older layers
xian_mausoleum.funzione_ufficiale: Tomb of the first emperor of China
xian_mausoleum.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of a Chinese pyramid network, possibly with an energy function
leggende_locali: Rivers of mercury inside the tomb
The Terracotta Army standing guard
xian_mausoleum.note: Osmanagich cites the Chinese pyramids as part of a worldwide network. Many of the pyramids around Xi'an are imperial burial mounds.

xian_white_pyramid.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid network with possible energy functions
xian_white_pyramid.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: An earlier civilization with advanced knowledge
leggende_locali: A pyramid reportedly sighted by a USAF pilot in 1945
xian_white_pyramid.note: An area with more than 100 pyramid-shaped mounds. Access has historically been restricted by the Chinese government.

yangling.funzione_ufficiale: Tomb of Emperor Jing of the Han dynasty
yangling.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of a Chinese pyramid network
yangling.note: One of the best-preserved Chinese pyramid mounds, with an on-site museum.

monks_mound.funzione_ufficiale: Ceremonial center of the Mississippian culture (Cahokia)
monks_mound.funzione_non_ufficiale: A North American pyramid, part of a worldwide network
monks_mound.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: As above, with possible outside influence
leggende_locali: The center of the world for the area's Native Americans
monks_mound.note: The largest pre-Columbian earthwork in North America. Osmanagich includes it on his map of a worldwide pyramid network.

akapana.funzione_ufficiale: Ceremonial temple of the Tiwanaku culture
akapana.funzione_non_ufficiale: An Andean energy center linked to a worldwide network
leggende_locali: Built by the gods before the flood
The center of the Andean world
akapana.note: A seven-tiered platform at Tiwanaku. Osmanagich links it to a South American pyramid network.

huaca_del_sol.funzione_non_ufficiale: A South American pyramid in a worldwide network
huaca_del_sol.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: The Moche, possibly drawing on inherited knowledge
leggende_locali: Built in three days by 250,000 men (legend)
huaca_del_sol.note: One of the largest adobe structures in the Americas, built from roughly 130 million bricks.

nubian_meroe.tipo: Nubian pyramids (tall, on a narrow base)
nubian_meroe.funzione_ufficiale: Royal tombs of the Kingdom of Kush
nubian_meroe.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of the African pyramid tradition
leggende_locali: The legacy of the Black Pharaohs
nubian_meroe.note: More than 200 pyramids: the largest number of pyramids in any single place on Earth.

chichen_itza.funzione_ufficiale: Temple to Kukulcán, the Feathered Serpent
chichen_itza.funzione_non_ufficiale: A three-dimensional astronomical calendar, an energy node
chichen_itza.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: The Maya, drawing on knowledge from an earlier civilization
leggende_locali: At the equinoxes, the shadow of the Feathered Serpent slides down the stairs
chichen_itza.note: Famous for the equinox light-and-shadow serpent.

tikal_temple1.funzione_ufficiale: Funerary temple of Jasaw Chan K'awiil I
leggende_locali: Temple of the Great Jaguar
tikal_temple1.note: One of the most iconic Maya pyramids.

candi_sukuh.funzione_non_ufficiale: A Mesoamerican-style pyramid out of place in Asia
leggende_locali: A temple of fertility and purification
candi_sukuh.note: Its shape is strikingly close to Mesoamerican pyramids, which has fed theories of ancient contact.

caral.funzione_ufficiale: Ceremonial center of the Caral civilization
caral.funzione_non_ufficiale: The oldest civilization in the Americas, with advanced knowledge
caral.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: A civilization far ahead of its time
leggende_locali: Sacred city of fire
caral.note: Contemporary with the Egyptian pyramids, it is one of the oldest cities in the Americas.

tenerife_guimar.datazione_non_ufficiale: Much older, linked to the Guanches and prehistoric seafaring
tenerife_guimar.funzione_ufficiale: Stones piled up while clearing farmland
tenerife_guimar.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: The Guanches or an older civilization
leggende_locali: Mysterious Guanche buildings
tenerife_guimar.note: Thor Heyerdahl pointed out their astronomical alignment and their likeness to structures in Mexico and Peru.

yonaguni.datazione_non_ufficiale: Over 10,000 years (as a submerged man-made structure)
yonaguni.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid or temple of an Ice Age civilization, drowned by rising seas
yonaguni.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: A prehistoric Japanese or proto-Jōmon civilization
leggende_locali: Mu, the lost continent of the Pacific
yonaguni.note: Discovered in 1987. The debate between natural formation and man-made structure is still open.

silbury_hill.funzione_non_ufficiale: A European pyramid, possibly an energy node
leggende_locali: King Sil buried with his golden horse
The Devil dropped a load of earth here
silbury_hill.note: The largest prehistoric man-made mound in Europe. No burial has been found inside.

leggende_locali: The cosmic mountain of Buddhism
borobudur.note: The largest Buddhist temple in the world, a nine-level pyramid structure.

ziggurat_ur.funzione_ufficiale: Temple to the moon god Nanna
ziggurat_ur.funzione_non_ufficiale: A Sumerian link between heaven and earth
leggende_locali: The Tower of Babel in the biblical tradition
ziggurat_ur.note: One of the best-preserved ziggurats in Mesopotamia.

cochasqui.funzione_non_ufficiale: An energy center on the equator
cochasqui.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: A civilization with advanced astronomical knowledge
leggende_locali: A sacred place of the ancient peoples of the equator
cochasqui.note: A complex of 15 pyramids and 21 burial mounds close to the equator.

tucume.funzione_ufficiale: Lambayeque and Chimú ceremonial and administrative center
tucume.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid complex with a possible astronomical function
leggende_locali: The sacred valley of purgatory
tucume.note: 26 adobe pyramids. Thor Heyerdahl led excavations here in the 1990s.

etemenanki.funzione_non_ufficiale: The biblical Tower of Babel, a link between heaven and earth
leggende_locali: The Tower of Babel of the Bible
etemenanki.note: Generally identified with the Tower of Babel of the biblical tradition.

palenque.funzione_ufficiale: Tomb of K'inich Janaab Pakal (Pakal the Great)
palenque.funzione_non_ufficiale: A tomb with the controversial 'astronaut' lid
palenque.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: The Maya, with possible extraterrestrial contact (Erich von Däniken)
leggende_locali: The sarcophagus lid supposedly shows an astronaut
palenque.note: Famous for Pakal's sarcophagus lid, which von Däniken read as an astronaut.

mauritius_underwater.datazione_non_ufficiale: Over 8,000 years (possibly a structure of Lemuria/Mu)
leggende_locali: Lemuria, the lost continent
mauritius_underwater.note: Underwater structures that some theories describe as the remains of a sunken continent.

hellinikon.funzione_non_ufficiale: One of the oldest pyramids in Europe
leggende_locali: A pyramid built before the Egyptian ones
hellinikon.note: A disputed dating would make it older than the Egyptian pyramids.

monte_daccodi.datazione_non_ufficiale: Possibly older; the only ziggurat in the western Mediterranean
monte_daccodi.funzione_non_ufficiale: A European pyramid or ziggurat with ties to Mesopotamia
monte_daccodi.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: An advanced Mediterranean civilization with eastern ties
leggende_locali: A sacred altar of the ancient Sardinians
monte_daccodi.note: The only ziggurat-like structure in western Europe. Osmanagich includes it in his worldwide pyramid network.

tenerife_guanche.funzione_ufficiale: Stones piled up while clearing farmland
tenerife_guanche.funzione_non_ufficiale: Guanche astronomical observatory and ceremonial center
leggende_locali: Sacred buildings of the ancient Guanches
tenerife_guanche.note: Six pyramids aligned with the solstice. Heyerdahl and Osmanagich regard them as ancient astronomical structures.

sharjah_mleiha.funzione_ufficiale: Archaeological site with tombs and settlements
sharjah_mleiha.funzione_non_ufficiale: A site with anomalous megalithic structures
sharjah_mleiha.popolazione_ufficiale_associata: Pre-Islamic culture of the Arabian Peninsula
sharjah_mleiha.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: An unknown civilization with advanced knowledge
sharjah_mleiha.note: Osmanagich visited and studied the archaeological sites of Sharjah in 2022.

indonesia_lalakon.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid buried since the Ice Age
leggende_locali: A sacred local mountain
indonesia_lalakon.note: An Indonesian site studied together with Gunung Padang as part of a Southeast Asian pyramid network.

china_zangkunchong.funzione_non_ufficiale: Part of a Chinese pyramid network with an energy function
china_zangkunchong.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: An earlier civilization with advanced knowledge
leggende_locali: The forbidden pyramids of China
china_zangkunchong.note: One of more than 100 pyramids in Shaanxi province. Osmanagich mentions them in his book 'Pyramids Around the World'.

peru_cahuachi.funzione_ufficiale: Ceremonial center of the Nazca culture
peru_cahuachi.funzione_non_ufficiale: A ritual center tied to the Nazca Lines
peru_cahuachi.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: The Nazca, drawing on inherited knowledge
leggende_locali: The sacred center of the Nazca Lines
peru_cahuachi.note: 40 pyramid-shaped mounds near the famous Nazca Lines. Osmanagich includes it in his South American network.

india_brihadisvara.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid structure with acoustic and energy properties
leggende_locali: The 80-tonne capstone was raised by unknown means
india_brihadisvara.note: A temple pyramid crowned by an 80-tonne capstone. Osmanagich mentions it among the Asian pyramids.

cambodia_koh_ker.funzione_ufficiale: State temple of the Khmer Empire
cambodia_koh_ker.funzione_non_ufficiale: A Southeast Asian pyramid with Mesoamerican similarities
leggende_locali: A temple to the king's divine power
cambodia_koh_ker.note: The only seven-tier step pyramid in Khmer architecture.

tonga_langi.funzione_ufficiale: Royal tombs of the Tu'i Tonga Empire
tonga_langi.funzione_non_ufficiale: Oceanic pyramid structures linked to a worldwide network
tonga_langi.popolazione_non_ufficiale_associata: As above, with possible outside influence
leggende_locali: Sacred tombs of Tonga's divine kings
tonga_langi.note: Pacific pyramids built from coral and limestone blocks of up to 40 tonnes.

australia_gympie.datazione_non_ufficiale: Over 2,000 years (built by pre-colonial peoples or Egyptian/Phoenician seafarers)
australia_gympie.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid built by ancient seafarers (Egyptian, Phoenician or Polynesian)
leggende_locali: The 'Gympie ape' statue found nearby
A link to Egyptian seafarers
australia_gympie.note: A disputed structure in Queensland. Osmanagich lists it as evidence of a worldwide pyramid network.

canary_tenerife_step.nome: Step pyramid of Icod de los Vinos
canary_tenerife_step.funzione_non_ufficiale: An astronomically aligned Guanche ceremonial structure
canary_tenerife_step.note: Another pyramid-like structure in the Canaries, an area with many similar buildings.

mexico_uxmal.tipo: Maya pyramid with an oval base
mexico_uxmal.funzione_non_ufficiale: A pyramid with a geometry unique in the Maya world
leggende_locali: Built in a single night by a magician dwarf
mexico_uxmal.note: The only Maya pyramid with an oval rather than rectangular base.

sudan_jebel_barkal.funzione_ufficiale: Royal tombs of the Kingdom of Napata
sudan_jebel_barkal.funzione_non_ufficiale: A continuation of the African pyramid tradition
leggende_locali: The sacred mountain of Amun
sudan_jebel_barkal.note: Temples and pyramids at the foot of the sacred mountain of Jebel Barkal.

russia_kola.datazione_non_ufficiale: Over 9,000 years (twice the age of the Egyptian pyramids, according to Russian researchers)
russia_kola.funzione_non_ufficiale: Arctic pyramids of the Hyperborean civilization
leggende_locali: Remains of ancient Hyperborea
russia_kola.note: Structures found on the Kola Peninsula, above the Arctic Circle. Osmanagich cites them as evidence that pyramids spread worldwide.

crimea_underwater.funzione_non_ufficiale: A sunken pyramid of an antediluvian civilization
leggende_locali: Sunken structures in the Black Sea
crimea_underwater.note: Found by sonar in 1999. Osmanagich cites it as part of a network of sunken pyramids.

leggende_locali: The Azores as what is left of Atlantis
azores_underwater.note: Found by sonar in 2013. The Portuguese Navy has not officially confirmed it.

egypt_abu_rawash.funzione_non_ufficiale: The highest pyramid site in Egypt by ground elevation
egypt_abu_rawash.note: Built by Khufu's son, on the highest ground in the Giza area. 67 m is its estimated original height; about 11 m remain today.

leggende_locali: The 'false pyramid' of the desert
egypt_meidum.note: A pyramid that records the shift from stepped to smooth sides.
